load_coco_json: load a COCO-format JSON annotation file and convert it to Detectron2 dataset dicts
register_coco_instances: register a COCO dataset instance with Detectron2 DatasetCatalog and MetadataCatalog
load_sem_seg: load semantic segmentation ground truth and input image files matching by filename
convert_to_coco_json: convert a Detectron2-registered dataset into COCO JSON format and save to a file
run_coco_loader: run the COCO JSON dataset loader CLI to load annotations and visualize dataset samples
